fields.System.Title: INV-202 — Query the movement ledger
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want to search stock movements, so that I can see
exactly what happened to a product or location and when.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a product, a location, a batch, or a date range, then I can filter by any
  • combination.
  • - Given results, then they are ordered by time and paginated.
  • - Given a movement, then the response includes the actor, the reason code, and the
  • source document reference.
  • - Given a correlation ID, then I get every movement caused by that one request.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory |
| Tables | stock_movement |
| Risks | Unindexed queries over a table that only ever grows |
| Tests | integration |
